scene.note: Ailsa hands your functions whatever each team says, and each function gives its answer back for the log.

steps.note: Each team gives its call sign, with stray spaces and small letters.
Ailsa calls clean_call_sign with the call sign as it was heard.
The tidy call sign comes back to the line that called the function, ready for the log.
Each team says how many crew went out.
crew_text decides which words fit the number, and gives them back.
Every path through the function ends by giving something back.
Any radio's charge, drain and low mark go in, in that order.
Inside, a loop counts the hours on the values the function was given.
Only once the loop has finished does the count come back.
log_line is given a call sign as heard and a number of crew.
It calls the two functions from before, one for each part of the line.
One whole log line comes back, the same shape for every team.
